2949-parallel-vector-multiplication.md.summary: Parallel Vector Multiplication is a GPU primitive where each thread independently multiplies corresponding elements from two input arrays, distinguished by requiring no inter-thread communication or synchronization.

3201-parallel-direct-compositing.md.name: Parallel Direct Compositing
3201-parallel-direct-compositing.md.summary: Parallel Direct Compositing is a distributed volume rendering technique where processors render local subimages and send them to a host for aggregation, simplifying communication at the cost of a serial display bottleneck.

3209-cuda-opengl-buffer-interoperability.name: CUDA-OpenGL Buffer Interoperability

6265-parallelism-and-distribution.md.name: Parallelism and Distribution
6265-parallelism-and-distribution.md.summary: Parallelism and Distribution maps volume rendering computations across multiple processing units to handle datasets exceeding single-device capabilities, distinguishing itself by addressing inter-node communication, load balancing, and distributed memory management.

3554-parallel-image-compositing-with-ove.summary: Parallel Image Compositing with Overlapping is a distributed rendering strategy where ray segments are transmitted to responsible processors immediately upon generation, rather than waiting for local ray-tracing to complete. 4039-ray-compaction.md.name: Ray Compaction
4039-ray-compaction.md.summary: Ray Compaction filters terminated rays and compacts active ones into a dense buffer using atomic indexing, differing from InK-Compact by avoiding separate prefix-sum launches.

4073-ray-buffer-reordering.md.name: Ray Buffer Reordering
4073-ray-buffer-reordering.md.summary: Ray Buffer Reordering is a GPU kernel primitive that compacts a list of active rays by moving them from a current buffer to a next buffer, effectively removing terminated rays. 6991-in-kernel-stream-compaction-ink-com.summary: InK-Compact is a GPU kernel primitive that compacts valid elements into a contiguous array while preserving order, avoiding global memory writes for invalid elements and eliminating inter-kernel dependencies to minimize synchronization overhead.

7270-out-of-kernel-compaction-ofk-compac.name: Out-of-Kernel Compaction (OfK-Compact)
7270-out-of-kernel-compaction-ofk-compac.summary: Out-of-Kernel Compaction removes invalid rays by invoking host-side library functions after rendering, offering simpler implementation at the cost of synchronization overhead compared to in-kernel methods.

6359-manager-workers-parallel-implementa.name: Manager/Workers Parallel Implementation
6359-manager-workers-parallel-implementa.summary: Manager/Workers Parallel Implementation is a distributed task-scheduling architecture that uses a central manager to dynamically assign work to workers, ensuring load-balanced execution on clusters with varying processor availability.

6889-sort-last-parallel-rendering.md.name: Sort-last Parallel Rendering

8196-remote-rendering-client-server-arch.name: Remote Rendering Client/Server Architecture
8196-remote-rendering-client-server-arch.summary: Remote Rendering Client/Server Architecture centralizes volume rendering computation on a server, sending only final images to a thin client to overcome local hardware limits.

8490-asynchronous-udp-client-server-volu.name: Asynchronous UDP Client-Server Volume Rendering
8490-asynchronous-udp-client-server-volu.summary: Asynchronous UDP Client-Server Volume Rendering is a distributed architecture that offloads rendering to a server, using UDP to ignore intermediate updates and process only the latest request, thereby reducing interaction latency.

8788-parallel-sort-last-image-compositin.name: Parallel Sort-Last Image Compositing for Volumes

9377-direct-send-compositing.md.name: Direct Send Compositing
9377-direct-send-compositing.md.summary: Direct Send Compositing is a parallel image compositing method for sort-last rendering that uses a single all-to-all communication stage to exchange screen-space tiles, distinguishing itself from hierarchical methods by avoiding multi-step trees.

12057-tiling-compositing.md.name: Tiling Compositing
12057-tiling-compositing.md.summary: Tiling Compositing is a parallel strategy where processing elements merge partial image tiles in a staggered linear chain, keeping all processors busy unlike the inverted binary tree method.

6893-sort-middle-parallel-rendering.md.name: Sort-middle Parallel Rendering
6893-sort-middle-parallel-rendering.md.summary: Sort-middle parallel rendering transforms primitives before distributing them to rasterizers by screen region, reducing network traffic compared to sort-first methods.

7094-temporal-division-of-uniform-resolu.name: Temporal Division of Uniform Resolution Data

11442-hybrid-distributed-memory-parallel.name: Hybrid Distributed-Memory Parallel Volume Rendering

9054-gpu-asynchronous-streaming.md.name: GPU Asynchronous Streaming
9054-gpu-asynchronous-streaming.md.summary: GPU Asynchronous Streaming uses separate OpenGL contexts to enable true concurrency, allowing the GPU's Copy Engine to overlap data transfers with rendering and avoid CPU-GPU synchronization bottlenecks.

9634-transform-feedback-gpgpu.md.name: Transform Feedback GPGPU
